## Testing

<!-- Commands run, and any manual PipeWire testing performed. -->

- [ ] `cmake --build build`
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure`

## Checklist

- [ ] User-visible behavior is documented (README, config comments or man page).
- [ ] Safety of stream restore/teardown was considered.
- [ ] No secrets, personal audio stream names or unrelated changes are included.
